buyer: Analysts moving from sell-side to buy-side
pain: The transition is opaque and one interview process decides a career
verdict: Warm, easy, and immediately sellable - but low leverage and low ceiling.

why.distribution: Her network and its natural referrals; candidates find coaches by word of mouth.
why.demand: Career coaching in finance is a real paid market.
why.fmf: She has been through the process and been on the hiring side.
why.defensibility: Coaching is unprotectable and the market is crowded.

ceiling_arithmetic: £1,100 x 60 candidates = £66k, requiring roughly 180 coaching sessions. Structurally capped far below target.
carries: Immediate, easy revenue and genuine authority.
kills: Structurally capped. One-to-one coaching at four figures cannot reach £200k.
test: Offer three sessions at £1,000 to two contacts' juniors.
test_fail: They expect it as a favour.
